items.title: 4.2.1 Stack: Best for LIFO Problems (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of when to use a stack (PDF 117).

blocks.text: Kab istemal karein: jab data ko us ki aamad ki ulti tarteeb mein process karna ho to stack behtareen hai. Isay 'Last-In, First-Out' (LIFO) kehte hain. Stack wahan kaam aata hai jahan wapas jana (backtrack) pare, jaise web pages mein pichhle page par wapas jana, ya hisabi expressions hal karna. Aam istemal:

items: Expression evaluation: infix expressions ko postfix ya prefix mein badalna aur unhein hal karna.
Backtracking algorithms: jaise maze (bhool bhulaiyan) wali paheliyan hal karna, ya graph mein Depth-First Search (DFS).
Undo: text editor jaise software mein sab se taaza kaam wapas lena.

blocks.prompt: Browser ka Back button stack ke liye kyun munasib hai?
blocks.explanation: Sab se aakhir mein khola gaya page sab se pehle wapas aata hai: last in, first out.

items: Stack: ulti tarteeb (LIFO) wale kaam: expressions, backtracking, undo.
